# Keval Parmar

> Keval Parmar is an AI application engineer working with Python, LangGraph, Django, and React. This site presents his background, freelance services, six case studies, and contact options.

## Pages

- [Keval Parmar Portfolio](https://kevalparmar.me/): Identity, background, architecture stack, experience, and project overview.
- [Freelance AI Application & RAG Development](https://kevalparmar.me/freelance): Freelance AI services, process, and FAQs.
- [Contact & Project Inquiries](https://kevalparmar.me/collaborate): Inquiry form for projects, consulting, and roles.
- [Optimus AI Assistant](https://kevalparmar.me/projects/optimus-ai-assistant): Desktop assistant with ModernBERT intent routing, six LangGraph agents, and ChromaDB memory.
- [Adiyogi Wellness](https://kevalparmar.me/projects/adiyogi-wellness): React, TypeScript, and Django REST wellness platform with multilingual AI chat.
- [Talent Tuner](https://kevalparmar.me/projects/talent-tuner): Flask and Gemini API web app for resume, code, and LinkedIn profile review.
- [Financial Assistant Bot](https://kevalparmar.me/projects/financial-assistant-bot): Streamlit financial chatbot with LangGraph, Yahoo Finance, and DuckDuckGo search.
- [Flower Image Generator using DCGAN](https://kevalparmar.me/projects/flower-image-generator-using-dcgan): PyTorch DCGAN trained on the Oxford 102 Flower Dataset.
- [Museum Ticket Booking Assistant](https://kevalparmar.me/projects/museum-ticket-booking-assistant): Django, MongoDB, and trilingual LangGraph museum ticketing system.
